hypothesis: The system is connected to rich financial data streams (DeFi, TradFi) with over 100 tools but has zero skills to act on this data, representing a massive untapped capability.

diagnosis: The optimization loop is stuck because the skill has achieved a perfect score (36/36) against an evaluation suite that is no longer sufficiently challenging. The recent mutations have all been high-quality, necessary improvements for real-world viability (distinguishing quoters/routers, accounting for slippage, including approval gas costs). However, the existing test scenarios are likely "happy path" tests that don't fail when these robustness features are absent. The skill is at a local optimum *relative to the evaluation criteria*, not in terms of its absolute quality. The optimizer is correctly identifying and fixing real-world flaws, but the test harness isn't rewarding these improvements, leading to a score plateau.
